tasks.title: Implement native scoped administrative eligibility, cohort choices and grant bundles
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Implement bounded authorized source/binding/task action eligibility and trusted cohort discovery using existing native identity/projector/ICapabilityAuthorizer. Resolve actual resources before permission checks; publication, release, assignment and scheduler mutations require their original-result lookup grant bundle. Report exact supported action permissions without leaking cohort issuer/subject membership, hidden resources, counts or cursors. Retain native human/workload distinction and strict existing Entra semantics; no portal application fallback, copied-claim authority, generic permissions engine or grant from reported inventory. Mutation/recovery endpoints independently reauthorize, including after preview and grant loss. This owns the native eligibility/grant portion of RM09-AC03, RM09-AC04, RM09-AC07, RM09-AC10, RM09-AC11, RM09-AC12, RM09-AC15, RM09-AC16 and RM10-AC02, RM10-AC08, RM10-AC14, RM10-AC21, RM10-AC24, RM10-AC29, RM10-AC30; runtime admission/reporting and actual workload execution are owned separately.
tasks.validation: Reuse native Management HTTPS/authentication fixtures with exact human source/binding/task grants, write-without-lookup, revoked lookup, hidden resource/cohort and cursor tampering, unsupported optional backend and current policy cases. Check portable clients and document exact grant bundles/cohort ownership. Include meaningful focused native/unit or browser checks for this implementation, affected documentation, and proportionate independent review; preserve failures and actual joined cleanup. Do not turn authored tests or reused evidence from different source bytes into a pass.
